prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Create one isolated full-body character master for Armax Relay Clash, from the supplied production model sheet of the Kett Anointed in Mass Effect Andromeda by Frederic Daoust. The exact subject is the Anointed, not a Chosen, Ascendant or generic Kett.
Use the LEFT figure of this reference as the pose guide: whole body in three-quarter profile facing right, arms relaxed, hands empty. Preserve its stocky broad-shouldered proportions, pale porous bony head crest, dark face and small pale eyes, enormous layered bone protrusions on both shoulders, bone ridges on the elbows and outside thighs, olive-green armor, wide upturned collar, round mechanical chest elements and small white chest light, black ribbed undersuit, tubular side connections, heavy shin armor and broad split-toe boots. Reproduce the asymmetric small details actually visible in the reference. Do not invent equipment, weapons, swords, ammunition, a cloak, tail, or new bone spikes.
Rendering should remain close to the supplied Frostbite game-model presentation, with restrained material texture and neutral balanced light. Single character only. Both hands and both boots fully visible; all shoulder and head projections inside the frame. No model sheet, no text, no logos, no other character, no ground shadow or base.
True transparent RGBA background. Give generous empty space on every edge: the character should occupy only 80 percent of canvas height. Leave clear space below both boot soles and above the crest. Target a clean production reference asset, not a dramatic illustration.
